steps.instruction: Melt 1 1/2 sticks of butter in the microwave or a small pan.
steps.spoken: Melt 1 1/2 sticks of butter in the microwave or on the stove in a small pan.

steps.instruction: Pour a little water into the bottom of a double boiler.
steps.spoken: Pour a small amount of water into the bottom of a medium double boiler. The water must not touch the bowl. Put the bowl off to the side.

steps.instruction: Bring the water to a simmer over medium heat, then lower the heat.
Put 3 egg yolks and 1 teaspoon of water in the bowl.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 2 teaspoons of lemon juice.
Add 1/8 teaspoon of cayenne pepper and 1/8 teaspoon of white pepper.

steps.spoken: Whisk the mixture for 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.instruction: Add the melted butter a little at a time, whisking well.
steps.spoken: Add the melted butter a little at a time. Whisk until the butter is mixed in and the mixture puffs up.

steps.instruction: Set the bowl over the simmering water and whisk for 3 minutes.
steps.spoken: Set the bowl over the simmering water and whisk for 3 to 5 minutes, until the sauce is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon.

steps.instruction: If it gets too thick or splits, whisk in a little hot water.
steps.spoken: If the sauce gets too thick or splits, whisk in very small amounts of hot water until it comes back together.
